contract.optimizer: Kerdoios only; catalog contains no ranking or optimization
contract.opencode: Only Go/Zen models with sourced free_status=true; paid and unproven-free aliases are excluded
contract.subscription: List prices are API equivalents, not actual billed spend; account pools are shared
contract.timing: TTFT quantiles use recorded ttft fields only; wall duration is never TTFT
contract.acceptance: Only canonical measured exact-task rubric_draft_quality priors or receipt-verified product outcomes become p_accept; generic proxies and vendor scores never do
contract.freshness: Each metric retains observation time; generated_at is not source freshness
contract.privacy: No credentials, prompts, responses, emails or raw account IDs are retained
